description: CGV-7 Activities (settings half REAL via GET/PUT /settings; history as a labeled placeholder since no client endpoint exists) and CGV-8 Backup (REAL backend: export via expo-file-system + expo-sharing, import via expo-document-picker, admin-only). Grouped as the final FEAT: both lean on real backend endpoints and both carry the no-clinical-score constraint / native file packages. Installs expo-file-system, expo-sharing, expo-document-picker. Also updates verification.md with the honest live-vs-stub split and the build-gate evidence for the whole task. Depends on FEAT-001. Independent of FEATs 002, 003, 004.
steps: Read context.json and this FEAT file FIRST.
From mobile/ install the native file packages: `npx expo install expo-file-system expo-sharing expo-document-picker` (NOT npm i).

Rebuild app/(caregiver)/activities.tsx. Settings half (REAL): load getSettings() -> SettingsValues; edit game_topics (multiselect over the 5 GameTopic values: family_names/relationships/routines/familiar_places/recent_events), game_difficulty (segmented 1/2/3), trivia_frequency_min (numeric minutes), quiet_hours.start and quiet_hours.end (TextInputs with HH:MM hint). Save via updateSettings(partial) and update local state from the returned full SettingsValues. loading/error/empty states.

Activities history: the client exposes NO games/activity-history endpoint — render a clearly-labeled placeholder section ('activity history will populate once the Games module lands (GAM-*)'). Do NOT invent a client call. If/when wired, use ActivityKind/ActivityOutcome labels. Include visible UI text stating that activity is for engagement and is NOT a clinical assessment, and show outcomes/topics only — never a score (hard product constraint).

Rebuild app/(caregiver)/backup.tsx. Export (REAL): call exportBackupUrl() -> absolute URL; download the zip with expo-file-system (FileSystem.downloadAsync to a documentDirectory path, e.g. echovault-backup-<timestamp>.zip); then offer expo-sharing (Sharing.isAvailableAsync() then Sharing.shareAsync(uri)) so the caregiver can save/find it. Report where it was saved.

Backup Import (REAL): pick a .zip with expo-document-picker (DocumentPicker.getDocumentAsync({ type: 'application/zip' })). On a picked file show an explicit confirmation Alert that CLEARLY states the current data will be REPLACED, then build an UploadFile { uri, name, type: 'application/zip' } and call importBackup(file, true). Report success using ImportResult.detail and report failure clearly.

Import is admin-only (backend require_admin): read the caregiver's access_level (call me() from src/api/auth, or read a stored access_level) and if not 'admin' surface a clear 'import needs an admin caregiver' message and disable the import control; also handle a 403 ApiError the same way. me() may 404 while auth is a stub — treat that as 'unknown/non-admin' and show the message rather than crashing.

Update mobile/verification.md: record npm install result, full npx tsc --noEmit output (zero errors), and the grep -rn 'fetch(' app result (empty). Add a per-screen live-vs-stub table — LIVE now: Dashboard (GET /dashboard), Activities settings (GET/PUT /settings), Backup (GET /backup/export, POST /backup/import). STUB (404 until module lands; UI complete): PIN/auth, Memories, People, Schedule, Medications, Activities history. State plainly that on-device Expo Go behavior and live calls against stubbed modules were NOT run here.
Add inline code comments noting the activities-history and auth stubs.
acceptance_criteria: Activities: topics, difficulty, trivia frequency and quiet hours can be changed and are saved via updateSettings; the screen states activity is not a clinical assessment and shows no scores.
Backup export calls exportBackupUrl(), downloads the zip via expo-file-system, and offers it via expo-sharing so the caregiver can find it.
Backup import picks a zip via expo-document-picker, confirms with an explicit 'data will be replaced' message, and calls importBackup(file, true); success and failure are both reported clearly.
Import is gated to admin caregivers (access_level check and/or 403 handling) with a clear message when not admin.
expo-file-system, expo-sharing and expo-document-picker are installed via `npx expo install` and appear in package.json.
verification.md records the build-gate evidence and the honest live-vs-stub split.
From mobile/: npm install succeeds, npx tsc --noEmit prints zero errors, and grep -rn 'fetch(' app returns nothing.
findings: Installed via `npx expo install`: expo-file-system ~18.0.12, expo-sharing ~13.0.1, expo-document-picker ~13.0.3 (in package.json). Rebuilt app/(caregiver)/activities.tsx: settings half REAL via getSettings/updateSettings (game_topics multiselect over the 5 GameTopic values, game_difficulty 1/2/3 segmented, trivia_frequency_min numeric with whole-number validation, quiet_hours start/end HH:MM TextInputs); saves a partial and adopts the full SettingsValues the hub returns; loading/error/empty states. Activity history is a clearly-labeled placeholder (no invented client call) that references the Games module GAM-*. Visible text states activities are for engagement and are NOT a clinical assessment; no scores anywhere. Rebuilt app/(caregiver)/backup.tsx: export resolves exportBackupUrl(), downloads the zip with FileSystem.downloadAsync to documentDirectory/echovault-backup-<timestamp>.zip, reports the saved uri, and offers it via Sharing.isAvailableAsync()+shareAsync(). Import picks a .zip with DocumentPicker.getDocumentAsync({type:'application/zip'}), shows an explicit 'data will be REPLACED' Alert, builds an UploadFile and calls importBackup(file,true); success uses ImportResult.detail, failure is reported. Import is admin-only: auth.me() access_level checked (me() 404 while auth stub => treated as non-admin), control disabled with a clear message; a 403 ApiError is handled the same way. All I/O goes through src/api/* (no raw fetch in app/). Inline comments note the activities-history and auth stubs. Build gate (from mobile/): npm install exit 0; npx tsc --noEmit zero errors; grep -rn 'fetch(' app empty. verification.md updated with the Module 16 build-gate evidence and the live-vs-stub table. NOT run here: on-device Expo Go boot and live calls against stub modules (auth/memories/people/schedule/medications and the Games history endpoint).
